review_type: Independent read-only mathematical preservation review of original-paper prose restoration
method: Reviewed every changed prose hunk and changed proof against the baseline and protected correction record; compared selected passages against the primary paper texts; independently checked raw displays, statement/proof environments, labels, aliases, Lean badges and balanced heading texts. No edits or builds performed by this reviewer.
display_count_convention: Outermost displayed-math blocks as parsed by reports/prose-concision/audit_concision.py; nested aligned/cases structures are not counted separately.

semantic_checks: All theorem, lemma, definition, proposition, corollary and proof environments are byte-identical to the baseline.
Absolute-curvature profiles, exact smooth-activation formulas, multivariate softmax lift and network-composition hypotheses are unchanged.
Stopping-stream monotonicity is restricted to activation-pattern cells; regularized gate selection and regularity hypotheses are retained.
Backward shifting retains strict-gate derivative scope, the balanced-input one-half factor, corrected index ranges, and the ungated affine readout.
Forward cache corrections target the real-arithmetic invariant; floating-point exactness is not promised.
Input-dependent recentering and winner-take-all pooling remain distinguished from structural convexity and monotonicity.
Cached ReLU positivity masks and cached max-pooling winner indices are now explicitly distinguished.
ReLU-subnetwork replacements of smooth activations remain explicitly approximate; the exact new curvature splits are separately retained.
All displayed mathematics, labels, aliases and Lean badges are byte-identical. All heading texts and their order are unchanged.
Changed theorem/definition wording is semantically equivalent; all hypotheses, conclusions, root conventions and boundary conventions are retained.
Changed proof prose preserves induction, signed recovery, selected backpropagation at ties and the active-player entropy credit.
Classical derivative claims remain restricted to open cells with nonzero ReLU preactivations and unique pooling winners.
Residual recovery retains the positive-arrival support qualification, explicit activation gates and counterexample; its theorem and proof are byte-identical.
The signed affine output bridge and its zero/negative output seed conventions are byte-identical.
Game-value discounts remain distinguished from attribution discounts, with absorption for bias, epsilon and empty streams.
Temperature deformation remains myopic with frozen temperature-one continuation values and no exactness claim away from the anchor.
ADF variance approximation, fixed-forward GELU/probit scope, conditioned LayerNorm implementation and Softplus split-head derivative qualification remain explicit.
The opening gradient representation now explicitly says discounted occupation measures.
All statement environments, displayed mathematics, labels, aliases, Lean badges and heading texts are byte-identical.
The complete constructive Transformer DC section, including softmax and LayerNorm theory, algorithm and proofs, is byte-identical.
Nonnegative-domain posynomial closure and difference/monotonicity remain distinct from convexity.
Linear-size expansion retains its bounded expanded-monomial requirement.
Nonempty attention masks and zero-mass cemetery completions are retained.
Composite attention applies alpha/beta once, with bias and stabilizer absorption retained.
Conditioned Value-only routing, frozen LayerNorm mean and scale, conditioned GELU gates and zero Q/K gradients remain distinct from the full analytical DC construction.
Transform averaging remains a heuristic for the implemented transform family without an asserted exact group-invariance guarantee.

resolved_findings.issue: Restored wording grouped max-pooling with ReLU positivity masks; pooling instead needs winner indices.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent restored the distinction between cached positivity patterns and pooling-winner indices, respectively.

resolved_findings.issue: The restored opening omitted the word discounted although the later definition remained correct.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent added discounted to the opening occupation-measure description.

remaining_paper_wording_opportunities.recommendation: No additional obvious change recommended in these mathematical chapters. Further restoration of duplicated arguments or unqualified original claims would weaken concision or the corrections already retained.
